consent_p1: SWARTHIKA is a supportive tool designed to assist trained counsellors in understanding your current distress and stress level in real-time.
consent_p2: Voice or written messages may be analyzed using speech acoustic and linguistic patterns to prioritize appropriate human care.
consent_p3: Human counsellors review every assessment. This system does not replace medical or psychological diagnosis.
consent_p4: You can stop the session at any time. Your personal information is kept strictly confidential and protected.
